verdict.rationale: The skill ships dependency-free Python tools that run outside a chat UI: SVG auditing, test sheets, PNG rendering, favicon/manifest export, a command-line-searchable logo library and a packaging script. These could plausibly be scripted. However, the core design workflow is explicitly interactive, producing nothing further until the user picks a direction at a checkpoint. Nothing documents headless or CI use. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless mode for the design workflow, CI integration examples, CLI usage docs for the tools, independent corroboration of automated runs.
